description: A permission block with a skill key that asks by default, allows your own skill by name, and denies any skill whose name starts with experimental-.

steps.description: This gates which skills an agent may load, through the `skill` key in the `permission` block. It takes the same three values and the same last-matching-rule-wins ordering as the `bash` map from the earlier permission block.

`"*": "ask"` prompts you before any skill not matched later loads. `"commit-message": "allow"` allows your own skill by name, and `"experimental-*": "deny"` denies any skill whose name starts with `experimental-`.

steps.question: The page says the moment you install a skill from someone else, you switch the wildcard to which value and allow your own by name?

title: Gating Which Skills Load
